title: Demonstrations held in Paris amid anti-government protests across France

tea.why: People protested over cost of living, education, pensions, corruption, housing, and government policies.
tea.want: Better economic conditions, education, and policy changes.
tea.changed: Oct 26: Interior ministry stated around 410,000 joined nationwide protests, while union organizers estimated 800,000.

summary: Hundreds of thousands of people demonstrated across France in anti-government protests for the second consecutive week. In Paris, protests that were originally planned near the city center at the Bastille were relocated to Porte d'Italie, a move union organizers criticized as scandalous. The interior ministry stated that approximately 410,000 people joined 289 protests nationwide on Saturday, while union organizers from the General Confederation of Labor estimated turnout at around 800,000. Authorities deployed tens of thousands of police officers alongside helicopters, armored vehicles, and water cannons to maintain order following widespread unrest and looting the previous week.
response: Police deployed up to 70,000 officers alongside helicopters, armored vehicles, and water cannons. According to sources, officers unleashed tear gas and a water cannon to break up the demonstration in Paris.

crowd.text: Authorities estimated around 110,000 participants in Paris

updates.text: Police used tear gas and a water cannon in Paris during anti-government demonstrations.
Interior ministry reported about 410,000 participants across France, whereas union organizers estimated 800,000.
